newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni details main shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni details main shareholders.

text.p: The following is a list of the main shareholders of Komercni Banka a.s., the largest Czech commercial bank, as released by KB on Tuesday.
The Bank of New York ADR Department 9.99
The Central European Growth Fund plc 1.08

Note. A Komercni statement said that the total number of shareholders as of June 25 was 81,170, of which 543 were corporate entities holding some 93.26 percent. It added that foreign shareholders owned 21.38 percent of the bank. The statement said that members of the bank's board of directors and supervisory board held 0.0196 percent and 0.0213 percent respectively.
The Bank of New York is authorised by the Czech National Bank to hold the shares, which are owned by investors through Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs).
